skill.name: video-outpainting
skill.description: Extends a video's spatial canvas through RunComfy and Wan 2-7 Edit-Video. It supports aspect-ratio changes and recommends ComfyUI workflows for demanding seam quality.
skill.summary: Extend video canvases while preserving central subjects and motion.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, documentation links, and a disclosed credential path. Two external-command findings are confirmed because the skill recommends unpinned package installation and automatic package execution. User-controlled JSON is also placed inside single shell quotes without robust escaping, despite a claim that no shell-injection surface exists.

remediation.issue: User-controlled prompts and URLs are embedded in a single-quoted shell argument.
remediation.suggestion: Serialize values with a structured JSON tool and safely escape the complete argument. Add tests for apostrophes, newlines, and command substitutions.

remediation.issue: Installation examples execute an unpinned npm package, including automatic npx execution.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and require user confirmation before installation or npx execution. Document how users can verify package provenance.

content.user_title: Extend Video Beyond the Original Canvas
content.value_statement: Changing a video's aspect ratio can crop subjects or create empty space. This skill guides spatial extension through RunComfy while preserving central action.
actual_capabilities: Routes prompt-based canvas extension to Wan 2-7 Edit-Video through the RunComfy CLI.
Builds prompts for horizontal, vertical, and percentage-based spatial expansion.
Adds requirements for preserving central action, subject framing, lighting, and background style.
Recommends dedicated ComfyUI workflows when seam quality or temporal consistency is critical.
Explains CLI exit codes, output directories, authentication, and expected network endpoints.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, an authenticated account, a service token, and network access.
Wan 2-7 is not dedicated to outpainting, so seams and temporal consistency can vary.
Dedicated ComfyUI workflows require manual use in the RunComfy cloud interface.
Does not outpaint still images, extend video duration, or perform mask-driven video inpainting.

use_cases.title: Convert Social Video
use_cases.description: Expand a vertical clip to a horizontal format while keeping the speaker and action centered.

use_cases.title: Prepare Campaign Variants
use_cases.description: Create wider or taller versions of approved footage for placements with different aspect ratios.

use_cases.title: Modernize Archive Footage
use_cases.description: Plan spatial expansion for older 4:3 footage and select a workflow with stronger seam control.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Horizontal Expansion
prompt_templates.prompt: Outpaint [video URL] from 9:16 to 16:9. Extend matching scenery on both sides and keep the original subject centered.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a simple vertical-to-horizontal conversion.

prompt_templates.title: Directional Canvas Extension
prompt_templates.prompt: Extend [video URL] by [percentage] toward [direction]. Continue the existing environment, lighting, perspective, and camera distance.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when only one edge needs additional space.

prompt_templates.title: Continuity-Constrained Outpaint
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert [video URL] to [target ratio]. Preserve central action, framing, motion, lighting, depth of field, and background continuity throughout the clip.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when visual continuity matters across every frame.

prompt_templates.title: Quality-Routed Production Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess [video URL] for [delivery purpose]. Choose Wan 2-7 or a dedicated ComfyUI workflow, then define expansion, preservation, and seam-quality requirements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for advanced work with explicit delivery standards.

output_examples.input: Convert a vertical interview clip to 16:9 for an internal presentation.
output_examples.output: A 16:9 video with matching room detail added on both sides while the speaker remains centered.

output_examples.input: Expand a square product video into a wide campaign banner with strict edge quality.
output_examples.output: A recommendation to use a dedicated ComfyUI outpainting workflow, with continuity and seam requirements for production review.

output_examples.input: Add more ground below a walking subject without changing the original action.
output_examples.output: A directional outpainting request that extends the lower canvas and preserves motion, framing, lighting, and camera distance.

best_practices: State the target aspect ratio, extension direction, and approximate expansion before describing new scenery.
Repeat preservation requirements for subject framing, motion, lighting, camera distance, and background style.
Use a dedicated ComfyUI workflow for final advertising assets with strict seam or temporal consistency requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not request multiple large expansion passes when one controlled pass can reach the target ratio.
Do not use this skill to add frames in time or edit masked regions inside the original frame.
Do not place unescaped user prompts or URLs directly inside shell-quoted command arguments.

faq.question: Does this skill extend video duration?
faq.answer: No. It expands the visible canvas around existing frames but does not add frames before or after the clip.

faq.question: Which model does the CLI route use?
faq.answer: The default CLI route uses Wan 2-7 Edit-Video for prompt-driven spatial extension.

faq.question: Can it convert vertical video to horizontal video?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide a 9:16 to 16:9 conversion while requesting preservation of the central subject.

faq.question: When should I use a ComfyUI workflow?
faq.answer: Use one when final delivery requires strict seam quality, motion-aware fill, or stronger temporal consistency.

faq.question: What access does the skill require?
faq.answer: It requires the RunComfy CLI, authentication, network access, and permission to write generated files.

faq.question: Can it guarantee seamless results?
faq.answer: No. Results vary by source footage, motion, expansion size, model behavior, and workflow choice.
